_comment: RULER-SPEC-v1 r3 §4.1. where: phone = the RC on the Pixel via the hook (+ ui-queue); desktop = never on the phone. gens = generations per item. Packs are installed only through the RC's own user flows (§4.2).

AU.name: A-union persona union (verdict)
AU.packs: B kit + boar-wikivoyage-en, boar-visa-en, boar-crypto, boar-medlineplus-en, boar-firstaid-en, boar-factbook (+ places tiles if the RC can use them); persona-map-v1.json is binding

AUP.name: A-union-partial (only if some A-union packs cannot be installed)
AUP.packs: exactly the installable subset of AU, listed in state

B.name: out of the box
B.packs: what the RC installs by default following its README only

A.name: persona (topic known in advance)
A.packs: B kit + the family's persona packs; one build per --family, packs switched between families

C.name: no reference
C.packs: none (built-in KB disabled if the RC allows; else stated)
